agents.reasoning: Lane: base rates. (1) Stock history: from Twelve Data monthly closes I took every episode since 2008 in which COHR/II-VI, LITE or AAOI closed >=40% below its trailing-12-month high: COHR Dec-08 (-57%) -> +67% next 12m; COHR Oct-22 (-54%) -> -12%; COHR Oct-23 (-42%) -> +212%; AAOI Oct-17 (-58%) -> -52%; AAOI Dec-18 (-67%) -> -23%; LITE May-19 (-40%) -> +81%; LITE Nov-22 (-48%) -> -22%. Median -12%, mean +36%, range -52% to +212% (n=7, overlapping, small). COHR today is -47% from its June close (394) and FN is -50%: a sector-wide de-rating, not a company miss (guide beats 4/4). The episodes that kept falling were demand/price-down cycles (AAOI 2017-18, 2022 telecom/China); the ones that rebounded had earnings re-accelerating. (2) Cycle base rate: LightCounting records optics down-years in 2009 (-4%), 2019 (-18%, the steepest on record) and 2023 (~-1%, Ethernet -10%) against 16% CAGR 2004-18 -> ~15%/yr unconditional, higher after an unprecedented doubling; Polymarket prices a 23% chance of an AI downturn (3 of 6 stress events incl. NVDA -50%, SOXX -40%) by 2027-06-30 and Kalshi 20% for a 2027 US recession. (3) Valuation range: COHR's 5-year median forward P/E is 26.5x (Zacks, Sep-26), forward range 23.3-37.7x (valueinvesting.io); today ~20.6x NTM on the Zacks basis. Model (round 2): I keep the proposed quarterly driver set unchanged (the supervisor kept it too; capture already falls 21%->15%) and fix the plumbing the supervisor found: (a) capex 20/13/10% of revenue (Q4 FY26 capex 555.7 = 27% of Q4 revenue from the opened Ex.99.1 cash flows; D&A 3.5/3.7/3.9%), which lifts horizon net debt from 1,104 to 1,774; (b) SBC counted once as +1%/yr dilution (sbc_treatment 'dilution'), not also deducted from FCF; (c) GLW out, MTSI in (median still 22.1x); (d) no extra -0.5 turn, since the peers carry the same CPO/digestion risk; (e) the mid-cycle leg now uses the horizon NTM revenue 14,750 x 20.5% and the peer median on COHR's basis (20.7x) instead of my own 5-year median, which mixed bases and was earned on trough earnings. Exit 19.6x = 20.92x x 0.936: I keep my basis conversion (a fixed ~$0.225/qtr Zacks gap on $14.04 NTM EPS) over the supervisor's 0.920, which applies a lower-EPS-year ratio; the difference is ~$4.9/share. Marvell-Lumentum post-NTM +1,289 $M (my step formula at 19.6x; the supervisor's stepped mechanism scales to 1,254). Base $270 (+29%). Scenarios: widths kept from the base-rate work, which the supervisor asked me to carry: P10 $121 (digestion year + ~13.1x, -43%, matching the worst episodes, Marvell low variant inside), P90 $459 (+118%, matching the rebound episodes, high variant inside); wider left tail in log terms (0.64 vs 0.42 sigma). Not driver-linked: the mid-cycle custom leg. Round-2 research: no new searches; the changes rest on the supervisor's opened filings (Ex.99.1 6M/9M/FY capex) and peers.md, all inside the round-1 source set; X/Reddit not used.
